eyebrow: Plotly Express: DataFrame in, chart out
code:
import plotly.express as px

fig = px.scatter(
    customers, x="orders", y="spend",
    color="segment",
    hover_data=["age", "region"],
    title="Spend vs orders by segment")
caption: Hover data adds columns to the tooltip.

code:
fig.update_traces(
    marker={"size": 7, "opacity": 0.8})
fig.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    legend_title_text="Segment")
fig.show()
fig.write_html("spend.html")
caption: Traces = the marks. Layout = the whole chart.
